title: GUI4ProtectionStones
description: A modern configurable GUI/Menu addon for ProtectionStones.
body:
# 🛡️ GUI4ProtectionStones — Modern GUI Addon for ProtectionStones

A modern and configurable GUI addon for ProtectionStones.

GUI4ProtectionStones transforms the classic command-based ProtectionStones experience into a clean, intuitive and survival-friendly inventory GUI system for your Minecraft server.

Designed for modern survival servers, it allows players to manage protections, teleport, edit rules, and manage members directly through polished inventory menus.

---

## ✨ Core Features

* **Modern GUI system:** Clean inventory menus for protection management
* **Protection browser:** Filter protections by owned, shared, homes or all regions
* **Protection dashboard:** Centralized access to all management tools
* **Teleport system:** Safe GUI teleport workflow with warmups and validation
* **Members management:** Add and remove region members directly from menus
* **Co-owner system:** Manage trusted co-owners safely
* **Safe rule editor:** Curated WorldGuard-backed protection rule management
* **Rule presets:** Quickly apply predefined protection setups
* **Highly configurable:** Menus, sounds, titles, layouts, lore and messages
* **Survival-friendly:** Built specifically for survival and SMP servers
* **Update checker:** Optional admin version notifications
* **Safe reload system:** Runtime-safe config reloading and cleanup

---

## 🚀 Advanced Systems

* Anti-spam click protection
* Teleport revalidation system
* Movement cancel teleport handling
* Owner and admin validation
* Outsider-sensitive rule blocking
* Per-rule cooldowns
* Disabled-rule normalization
* Safe fallback handling for unsupported flags
* Compatibility-oriented ProtectionStones hook layer

---

## 🏠 Protection Management

GUI4ProtectionStones provides a fully visual way to manage player protections.

### Included Systems

* Main dashboard
* Protection browser
* Homes browser
* Members manager
* Co-owner manager
* Rule editor
* Teleport menus
* Protection detail menus

---

## ⚙️ Supported Protection Rules

The default curated rule set includes support for:

* PvP
* Entry
* Interact
* Chest access
* Mob spawning
* TNT
* Creeper explosions
* Fire spread
* Ender pearl usage
* Item pickup/drop
* Vehicle usage
* Sleep
* Respawn anchors
* Animal damage
* Enderman grief
* Chorus fruit teleport
* Potion splash
* Firework damage
* And more

All rules are safely integrated with ProtectionStones and WorldGuard.

---

## ⚙️ Commands

### Main Commands

| Command                 | Description    |
| ----------------------- | -------------- |
| `/gui4ps`               | Main command   |
| `/gui4protectionstones` | Alias          |
| `/gui4ps help`          | Help menu      |
| `/gui4ps version`       | Plugin version |

### GUI Commands

| Command                        | Description              |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------ |
| `/gui4ps open [player]`        | Open main GUI            |
| `/gui4ps protections [filter]` | Open protections browser |
| `/gui4ps homes`                | Open homes menu          |
| `/gui4ps current`              | Current protection menu  |
| `/gui4ps rules`                | Open rules editor        |
| `/gui4ps members`              | Open members menu        |
| `/gui4ps owners`               | Open co-owner menu       |
| `/gui4ps status`               | Show plugin status       |

### Admin Commands

| Command          | Description          |
| ---------------- | -------------------- |
| `/gui4ps reload` | Reload configuration |

---

## 🔐 Permissions

| Permission                      | Description           |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------- |
| `gui4protectionstones.use`      | Use plugin GUI        |
| `gui4protectionstones.reload`   | Reload configuration  |
| `gui4protectionstones.admin`    | Admin access          |
| `gui4protectionstones.teleport` | Use teleport system   |
| `gui4protectionstones.members`  | Manage members        |
| `gui4protectionstones.owners`   | Manage co-owners      |
| `gui4protectionstones.rules`    | Edit protection rules |

---

## 🎯 Perfect For

* Survival servers
* SMP servers
* Economy servers
* Towny-style experiences
* Community-focused servers
* Custom progression servers

---

## 🔌 Dependencies

Required:

* ProtectionStones
* WorldGuard *(depending on your PS version)*

---

## 💻 Compatibility

* Minecraft: 1.18 → 1.21.x
* Java: 17 or higher
* Platforms: Paper / Spigot

Revalidated Paper targets:

* 1.18.2
* 1.19.4
* 1.20.6
* 1.21.1+

---

## ❤️ Designed for Stability

GUI4ProtectionStones was built with safety and server stability in mind.

The plugin includes runtime-safe systems, compatibility validation, teleport safeguards and protected GUI workflows to prevent broken states and exploit scenarios while keeping the experience intuitive for players.

---

## 📦 Why GUI4ProtectionStones?

ProtectionStones is powerful, but command-heavy for many players.

GUI4ProtectionStones modernizes the entire experience by replacing complicated command workflows with intuitive menus, making region management easier, safer and far more enjoyable for your community.
